description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'SerializingCustomDatatype' implementing the 'CustomDatatype' interface, providing serialization/deserialization and validation mechanisms for custom data types in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: SerializingCustomDatatype
classes.description: An abstract class providing serialization, deserialization, validation, and summary functionalities for custom data types within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize a typed value into a String representation.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Abstract method to deserialize a String representation back into the typed value.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a plain-text summary of the typed value; default implementation uses toString().

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration options; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the typed value, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: fromReferenceString
methods.description: Converts a reference string into the typed value by deserializing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and serializes a typed value for storage.

methods.name: getReferenceStringForValue
methods.description: Gets the string reference for the given typed value.

methods.name: getTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of the value from its reference string.
